_comment: Copy to config.json (auto-generated on first run if absent). Leave wif/hmac_secret blank to auto-generate a fresh hot wallet + secret. NEVER commit config.json.
_behind_cloudflare_note: Set true ONLY if served behind Cloudflare with nginx real_ip configured (see deploy.py). It makes the app trust the CF-Connecting-IP header for per-IP limits; leaving it false is the safe default for any other setup.
